description: This file defines the 'ModuleActivator' interface for the OpenMRS project, which contains lifecycle methods invoked at various stages of a module’s execution, such as start, stop, and refresh events.

classes.name: ModuleActivator
classes.description: Interface that defines lifecycle callback methods for module activation events within OpenMRS.

methods.name: willRefreshContext
methods.description: Method called just before Spring's application context is refreshed, invoked multiple times during module start and application startup.

methods.name: contextRefreshed
methods.description: Method called after Spring's application context has been refreshed, usually after a module has started.

methods.name: willStart
methods.description: Method called after a module has been loaded but before the application context is refreshed.

methods.name: started
methods.description: Method called after a module has been fully started and its service methods are available.

methods.name: willStop
methods.description: Method called just before stopping a module.

methods.name: stopped
methods.description: Method called after a module has been stopped.
